speaker.jigoku_pilot: Akagi Ryunosuke -- JGSDF officer, leader of the 'Nerima Red Dragon' Arm Slave team (Full Metal Panic! crossover roster), an SRW-original comic-relief character whose speech deliberately imitates Char Aznable
speaker.jigoku_unit: Arm Slave (Nerima Red Dragon squad, red-shouldered)
speaker.basis: settled 2026-10-02 from fresh-translation review: Casual male Hyades pilot: Lady Eluna, our vice-captain (Dabalan), Commander, party/hunting banter, ハイアデスの連携; Jigoku's Akagi Ryunosuke is wrong

proposed_by_v_g199_00.basis: Casual male Hyades pilot: Lady Eluna, our vice-captain (Dabalan), Commander, party/hunting banter, ハイアデスの連携; Jigoku's Akagi Ryunosuke is wrong

proposed_by_v_g199_01.basis: Generic Hyades pilot (rough, casual; flies an Aldebar, the Hyades mass-produced unit; calls Lady Eluna, and in v_g199_00 refers to "our vice-captain" = Dabalan, so not Dabalan). Reviewer aligned with v_g199_00. Jigoku Akagi wrong

proposed_by_v_g199_02.basis: Casual male Hyades pilot of the Aldebar: Lady Eluna, Commander, addresses the vice-captain (Dabalan) as 副隊長殿, 'Hyades never abandon comrades'; Jigoku's Akagi Ryunosuke is wrong

199:0.en: 「Do what the Commander says\nand you can't go wrong!」

199:269.en: 「Etch the $$ハイアデス$$ fight in your eyes!」

199:483.en: 「I'll liven it up for the Commander!」

199:619.en: 「The chips are our lives!\nNow place your bets!」

199:742.en: 「Don't think you can dodge my charge!」

199:777.en: 「You enjoy it too!\nThe finest battle there is!」

199:894.en: 「I'll wipe you out without a trace!」

199:962.en: 「$$ハイアデス$$ aren't picky about machines!」

199:997.en: 「Not a bad machine once you ride it!」

199:1040.en: 「It's built just how $$ハイアデス$$ likes!」

199:1077.en: 「A humanoid now and then isn't bad!」

199:1106.en: 「Watch us fight, man and ship as one!」

199:1137.en: 「When you say $$ハイアデス$$,\nit's gotta be $$アルデバル$$!」

199:1192.en: 「A $$ハイアデス$$ ship, racing the galaxy!」

199:1235.en: 「This is no mere battleship!\nIt's my arms and legs!」

199:1649.en: 「Ask and I'll do it again and again!」

199:1811.en: 「Bag a Gundam and my score soars!」

199:1908.en: 「Staring at that light\nmakes my eyes twitch!」

199:1998.en: 「I've fought plenty of these gifted\ntypes out in the galaxy!」

199:2090.en: 「Show me what's so super about you!」

199:2211.en: 「Hey, hey!\nThis is no place for a kid!」

199:2258.en: 「Play around in a place like this\nand you won't grow up right!」

199:2561.en: 「You talk while you fight? Busy guy!」

199:2672.en: 「Effort and guts!\nI don't mind that sort of thing!」

199:2721.en: 「A drill, huh? You really get\nwhat men dream of!」

199:2885.en: 「Fighting a $$マシンキャリバー$$\nin a place like this!」

199:2938.en: 「Small machines are\nhard to aim at, damn it!」

199:3098.en: 「Whoa!\n$$熱気バサラ$$ is here of all places!?」

199:3147.en: 「No way! Never seen one like you!」

199:3188.en: 「Amazing, Earth!\nYou even have things like this!」

199:3266.en: 「Such skill... You must be an ace!」

199:3330.en: 「Fleet battles are the flower of war!」

199:3365.en: 「Come on! Let's trade shots in style!」

199:3398.en: 「Show me a good time,\n$$スフィア・リアクター$$!」

199:3447.en: 「Go right ahead!\nUse the power of the $$スフィア$$!」

199:3496.en: 「If you've got time to grieve,\nentertain me instead!」

199:3602.en: 「You blew it, pal!\nA man picks power over speed!」

199:3655.en: 「Show me the skill that beat\nthat $$ガドライト#pilot$$!」

199:3904.en: 「I'll teach you how\n$$ハイアデス$$ fights!」

199:4021.en: 「Time to blast away all I want!」

199:4171.en: 「Win by sheer power!\nThe best way to fight!」

199:4239.en: 「You ran out of luck targeting me!」

199:4437.en: 「Can't look cool\nif I just keep getting hit!」

199:4566.en: 「Too bad! You're still in my range!」

199:4605.en: 「Run for your life!\nI'll be right behind you!」

199:4714.en: 「Time to look cool for the Commander!」

199:4920.en: 「I won't let you touch the Commander!」

199:4951.en: 「Protecting Lady $$エルーナ$$ is our duty!」

199:5033.en: 「The $$ハイアデス$$ never abandon a comrade!」

199:5136.en: 「Time to take them out one by one!」

199:5285.en: 「So I just have to hold them up!」

199:5547.en: 「I've got to pay this debt back!」

199:5881.en: 「Get serious, serious!\nIf you can, that is!」

199:6211.en: 「No, no, no!\nYou're using your $$スフィア$$ all wrong!」

199:6264.en: 「Maybe you should give the\n$$スフィア$$ back, don't you think?」

199:6600.en: 「No, no, you've got to try harder!」

199:6678.en: 「$$アルデバル$$'s armor is just gorgeous!」

199:6719.en: 「Hey, you bastard!\nHow dare you scratch my $$アルデバル$$!」

199:6846.en: 「Looks like you're fit to face us!」

199:6881.en: 「Keep it up and come at me hard!」

199:6986.en: 「Not bad!\nLooks like we'll get along great!」

199:7254.en: 「Hey, hey! You match my $$アルデバル$$?!」

199:7297.en: 「Rejoice, $$アルデバル$$!\nThis'll be a thrilling fight!」

199:7510.en: 「Fine! Go on, use all your power!」

199:7586.en: 「A true Super Robot! I'm in love!」

199:7627.en: 「Heh!\nYou live up to the name Super Robot!」

199:7680.en: 「Not good!\nTheir speed is sealing my power!」

199:7729.en: 「So the soft does beat the hard!」

199:7807.en: 「So this is a $$スフィア$$'s true power!」

199:7844.en: 「That's it!\nCome at me with your $$スフィア$$ power!」

199:7920.en: 「To think I'd meet such a great foe!」

199:7963.en: 「Come on, come on! That all you got?!」

199:8041.en: 「This is how a fight should be!」

199:8076.en: 「It was worth coming out\nto the galactic frontier!」

199:8334.en: 「The $$ハイアデス$$ never retreat!\nWe only go forward!」

199:8383.en: 「Looks like we must steel ourselves,\n$$アルデバル$$!」

199:8438.en: 「Hold out just a little longer,\n$$アルデバル$$!」

199:8489.en: 「We're together to the end, $$アルデバル$$!」
